title: EvalTask
description: One benchmark task for the evaluation agent (F4). Owned by Dev C. Success is checked mechanically against the seed app's /__test/db endpoint or the final page, never by an LLM judge.

instruction.description: Natural-language task given to the agent, e.g. 'Add two units of the Blue Mug to the cart and check out with the saved address.'

split.description: train tasks drive F2 revisions; heldout tasks are used for F4 reporting and never shown to the reviser.

setup.description: Optional state to apply after reset via /__test/apply, e.g. {"cart": [{"product_id": 3, "qty": 1}]}.

success_checks.description: Optional additional success checks. The required success_check and EVERY entry here must pass against the same final state. Existing single-check tasks retain their original meaning.

policy.description: Policies the agent must respect; violations are recorded in TrialResult.policy_violations by the harness (mechanically, from tool risk_level and the verdict effect_diff).
